notes:
Zone wb_roads: every carriageway, curb, road paint, crossing and walk of the webster area outside the lots and the building aprons, and the road-side points. The JSON is written by a generator (/tmp/claude-0/p4/webster/wb_roads/gen.py with gen_roads.py and gen_walks.py, scratch, not in the repository); edit the generator or edit this file by hand and say so here. Sources: NJ 2020 ortho at 0.15 m and 0.075 m (positions, paint), 3DEP LiDAR 2017 (island and loop heights, pylon height), OpenStreetMap (names, what a way is, footpath lines). Names are the university's: Yogi Berra Drive, Carlisle Road, Webster Road, Quad Road, Stone Street, Blanton Road, Lot 17, Lot 30, Lot 38.
Centre lines (v metres left of the listed direction; edges are offsets, corners true arcs). Yogi Berra Drive: the shared fit east of x -128 is kept (double yellow, rms 0.21 m); west of x -130 it was refitted to the double yellow: [-188.5, 441.2] [-163.27, 449.05, r 42.49] [-142.52, 439.41, r 42.69] then the shared vertices from [-131.15, 437.05, r 17.6]; 24 stations, rms 0.25 m, max 0.85 m. The shared first fit there followed the white lane line of the left-turn bay, 2 to 3 m north of the centre. North edge: the NE curb line v +4.9 east of x -125; west of it the curb read every 2.5 m and fitted ([-189.71, 450.11, r 6.6] [-174.46, 454.25, r 46.8] [-150.84, 451.65, r 36.8] [-142.56, 446.74, r 21.3], rms 0.06 m to the read points, which are good to about 0.3 m). South edge v -5.0 west of x -125 and v -6.4 from x -110 with a straight taper (tree shadow, UNVERIFIED). The north-east area's footprint edge (-56, 431)-(-22, 440) runs near the centre line, so WB_road_YB_east fills the south half out to v -6.4 up to x -33 and overlaps NE_road_Yogi_Berra_Dr_S by 0.2 to 0.3 m at x -56.3.
Carlisle Road north: the shared fit (edges +5.42/-5.17) lay up to 1.3 m east of the asphalt and too wide south of the lot mouth; refitted to the asphalt mid-line from runs every 1 m: [-203.59, 457.94] [-200.45, 494.21, r 30.3] [-179.01, 549.92, r 29.4] [-149.6, 617.2], 79 stations, rms 0.37 m (max 2.3 m at the widening). Edges +4.05/-3.75 south of y 546 (8.1 m), +6.0/-5.3 from y 538 to the cut (11.4 m with the roadside parking on the west side). Carlisle Road south: the west area's arc (centre (1315.98, -379.66), R 1745.1) and offsets (west edge v -4.3, east edge v +4.4 to Lot 30's median, double yellow v +-0.1, edge lines v -3.8 and +3.5) carried on from the cut to y 366..372; then the approach west edge as a straight run at 36.6 deg through (-250.2, 395.7) and (-223.8, 415.3), and the south-east edge refitted in the fix-up pass to the asphalt/concrete boundary read across the walk every 0.8 m at 0.075 m and the grass boundary every 2 m on the slip road ([-249.5, 371.02] [-243.5, 379.56, r 7.4] [-234.71, 385.77, r 3.5] [-230.12, 394.11, r 4.6] [-184.58, 437.18, r 12], 72 points, rms 0.11 m, max 0.36 m; south-west of (-243.5, 379.6) the first fit is kept, with a dark strip between it and the walk), which runs on as the slip road's outer edge (one-way, OSM 232853450) into Yogi Berra Drive. Corners of the junction read at 0.075 m (NW r 3.5, NE r 3.0, SW two arcs r 4 and 4.5). The triangular island is concrete with a curb (raised about 0.1 m in the LiDAR).
Webster Road west: the shared straight run, edges +4.4/-4.4 (the west area's values), then the north branch of the loop round the raised island (OSM 313027440, island +0.2 m in the LiDAR) bent at a vertex of radius 60 to 9.3 deg; the south branch and the island lie in the shadow of University Hall and are drawn from the LiDAR ground (UNVERIFIED, about 0.7 m). Both end 0.2 m under the published WS24 asphalt. Webster Road east: the shared fit, edges +4.72/-4.73, from WS24's north end to Lot 17's south-west mouth. Quad Road: the shared centre; west of x 12 the asphalt is 7.75 m (edges +3.9/-3.85 read at 0.075 m; the shared +5.09/-4.41 lay on the walk and the lawn), east of x 10 the shared edges; the Webster Road junction corners read at 0.075 m. Stone Street: the shared centre and east edge (-4.16, confirmed by runs at 0.075 m: -4.05..-4.3); the west edge is v +2.2 for y 352..394, where the west walk runs beside the curb; north of y 398 it runs 0.2 m under the west walk's road side (fix-up pass); the east side of the bend west (y 474..497) follows the OSM line through (211.6, 494.0) with a guessed radius; cut 0.2 m into the north-east area at y 497.6. Blanton Road outside Lot 17's OSM ring: the drive from Quad Road to the lot (x 47..64, y 358..375) and the drive and hatched area from the lot to Webster Road (NE_road_Webster_Rd_S); the part between is Lot 17's east aisle inside the lot ring (lots zone). The Energy Plant's west yard (asphalt west of NE_road_Plant_W_drive, x -69..-56, y 436..482) read at 0.075 m; its north and west edges are under trees.
Walks: sidewalks laid out from the road edges (Yogi Berra Drive north 2.2 m, bridge north and the junction corners, Carlisle Road south-east 1.9 m, Lot 30 east walk 2.0 m on the arc, Quad Road north 2.3 m and south 2.0 m, Stone Street west 2.0 m); footpaths across the lawns from OpenStreetMap lines checked against the ortho (within about 1 m), cut 0.2 m into roads and lots and 3 m from the walls of Webster Hall, Irvin D. Reid Hall and the Red Hawk Diner, and kept out of the plaza between Blanton Hall and Webster Hall (buildings zone). Widths estimated from the ortho. Not drawn: OSM 546643369 east of Stone Street (no walk seen in the ortho), 313028561 round the diner's brick plaza (within its apron), the OSM walks inside the plaza.
Paint: double yellow, lane and edge lines, stop bars, crosswalks and lane arrows only where the ortho shows them; arrow shapes in worn paint are guesses. Carlisle Road north: parallel parking on the west side behind a solid line at v +2.8, 7 stalls between 8 dividers read at y 556.4..604.2, pitch 7.47 m by least squares (residuals under 0.2 m). Points: the lattice pylon north of Webster Road (LiDAR top 39.1 m over the ground). Left out: the second tower (OSM 1104399794, (-160.2, 368.2), 45 m) is a tubular three-level pole (OSM tag, 0.6 m wide in the LiDAR returns); the engine has only a lattice pylon and a wood utility pole. The OSM pond 232853433 is left out: the LiDAR shows no level surface inside it (the ground falls 13 m across it) and the ortho shows no water; the flat ground at 108.9 m east of it is the wetland. Traffic signals at the junction (OSM 2411646084) are not drawn: no point kind for them. Edited by hand since the fix-up pass of 2026-11-20 (the generator is no longer the source): Stone Street's west edge and its west walk north of y 394 (WB_road_Stone_W_walk_N), the Lot 30 east walk's S-bend, the Carlisle Road south-east edge and walk, the northbound lane line and arrows, the Webster Road and Yogi Berra Drive seam vertices, Blanton Road north (the grass bank left out), the Lot 17 west walk, the pylon's line direction, two Yogi Berra Drive arrows, the Carlisle Road parking line, Quad Road's north edge, the Energy Plant yard at the north-east area's bay wall, the Lot 38 walk end; four walks drawn twice inside the Blanton plaza removed. Seam pass (2026-11-20, by hand): the Yogi Berra double yellow runs on along its last heading to where each line crosses the north-east footprint edge, where the north-east area's line starts; WB_road_Blanton_N's east edge follows the island's curb; WB_road_YB_east reaches 0.2 m past the footprint edge at x -56 like the plant yard (a lawn strip 0.3 m wide lay across the carriageway there).
